Jasmine / team — tagging in the operational details Samir asked for. Below are the practical options we support for Private/VPC deployments where customer controls storage: 

1) Remote attestation (standard) — low friction, auditable
   - What we do: run a coordinated wipe job that removes tenant snapshots, deletes objects from the customer-owned storage mount (we perform delete calls), rotate the KMS data key used for any ciphertext we issued, and then publish an immutable audit export (GZip CSV) with timestamps, request IDs, and before/after object counts.
   - Evidence produced: signed Certificate of Deletion (SHA256 hash of export), S3-like audit export, KMS rotation logs (if we managed keys).
   - Timeline: typical turnaround 3-5 business days after PO / approved handback window.

2) On-site witness (for high-assurance/regulatory needs) — higher assurance, extra coordination
   - What we do: schedule a mutually agreeable time on your premises or in your cloud account. Our engineer performs the wipe steps with your witness present (or an agreed third-party auditor). We use a pre-signed checklist (onsite-witness-sop.pdf) and both parties sign the handback form on completion.
   - Evidence produced: signed handback form (scanned), time-stamped console output and deletion request IDs, video/photo snapshots of the operations where permitted, and a Certificate of Destruction signed by Redwood.
   - Timeline: depends on scheduling; allow 1-2 weeks for coordination + paperwork. Additional travel/third-party fees may apply.

3) Customer-led verification (preferred if you retain control)
   - If Althrive runs the deletion commands, we provide a verification package: audit export, request IDs, and a small verification script that your security team can run against object metadata to confirm zero tenant objects.

Notes on KMS / keys:
- If Redwood manages encryption keys, we rotate and schedule deletion after the last retention window; rotation hashes are in the certificate.
- If you manage the keys (customer-managed CMK), you can revoke access immediately post-wipe — we include key access logs for the period leading up to the wipe.

Compliance considerations / exceptions:
- For SNCs requiring a SOC2 auditor on site, we will engage with your auditor via our legal and security teams.
- We can provide notarized/third-party auditor evidence if contractually required; cost and timeline vary.
